title: Worktree-observed Phase-14 gaps used as SYN-0003 input while SYN-0001 is absent
note: Not a substitute for SYN-0001.cause graph. Honest fixture so rival generation can be proven on a typed CAUSE|MECHANISM|SYMPTOM DAG of depth 2.

nodes.statement: The Phase-14 root-cause DAG was never written because SYN-0001 has no probe tree and no artifact on disk.
Without probes/SYN-0001/ there is no emitter that writes the catalog output_path.
Leftover units persist because workers treated cloud ok=true as G-1 delivery.
A remote ok flag is stored as completion without re-running named probes.
P2-CLOUD-LEFTOVER still lists SYN-0003 among remaining_ids.
Synthesis cannot attach Phase-12 rivals because command-center/adversarial/ is empty.
B10 catalog output_path points at adversarial/ while probe work landed under p2-wave/probes/ADV-*.
Glob of command-center/adversarial returns no files.
Long catalog completion_sentinel paragraphs make short SUCCESS:SYN-0003 tokens fail the measure substring check.
_measure_one_delivered.py requires the catalog completion_sentinel string inside the artifact bytes.
A short SUCCESS:SYN-0003 token is classified sentinel-absent even when probes are green.
UNKNOWNS-REGISTER.md is absent on this worktree, so residual unknowns never attach to a cause node.
SYN-0003 inputs name the unknowns register; the file was never authored here.

edges.mechanism: missing unit tree implies no writer
no emitter writes the catalog path
G-1 never ran so leftover remains
short token is not a substring of the paragraph
stat of the named path fails
